nosotros.slogan: Building the future with safe and reliable supplies for major infrastructure projects worldwide
nosotros.texto: Consorcio Qutub Minar is a company specialized in engineering, technical inspection, and supply logistics, dedicated to coordinating and supervising every stage of the procurement process in industrial and infrastructure projects. From design and manufacturing to testing, dispatch, tracking, and receipt of materials, we ensure compliance with the highest standards of quality, traceability, and operational efficiency.
nosotros.text2:
Thanks to an innovative model of technical and logistics control, we operate in an integrated manner in multiple countries, leveraging our global network to reduce risks, anticipate challenges, and maximize productivity. Our approach is based on agile execution, rigorous quality control, and transparent management that generates trust and sustainable results.
We work with integrity, commitment, and a clear vision: to transform the complexity of global projects into efficient, safe, and successful processes. The experience and trust of our clients reflect the strength of our values and the excellence of our team.
nosotros.titulo2: Qutub Minar Inc: Our global platform
nosotros.texto2: Qutub Minar Inc was born in the United States as part of our international expansion strategy. This subsidiary was created to meet the demands of global markets, offer proximity to our international clients, and strengthen our operational capacity in high-impact projects.
nosotros.texto3: From its headquarters in the USA, Qutub Minar Inc acts as a bridge between continents, facilitating the management of supplies, technical inspections, and logistics solutions with global reach. With strategic vision, regulatory compliance, and international support, we consolidate our presence in key markets, driving projects with efficiency, traceability, and technical excellence.
nosotros.mision: Consorcio Qutub Minar S.A.S is a national company that provides supervision and logistics control services for the supply of products and materials in the civil works, electrical, telecommunications, metalworking, and other engineering sectors, creating solutions and improving projects around the world.
nosotros.vision: To be a company with high worldwide recognition for supervision and logistics control services for the supply of products and materials, connecting all organization actors to improve productivity in their activities.

servicio.slogan:
We manage all key stages of your project, ensuring that supplies are designed, manufactured, dispatched, and received according to your needs.
We combine engineering, inspection, and logistics to guarantee quality, technical compliance, optimal timing, and maximum efficiency at every stage.
servicio.slogan2:
We coordinate and manage the entire project logistics chain, from manufacturing to delivery on site.
Our real-time traceability platform, together with efficient planning, guarantees reliable deliveries, resource optimization, and maximum operational efficiency at every stage of the supply.
servicio.texto1:
We provide specialized technical assistance throughout the project cycle. From engineering validation and factory supervision to testing and technical assurance, we ensure that each component meets the required standards in international energy and infrastructure projects.
Includes:
-Validation of designs and construction plans
-Technical supervision and production support
-Evaluation of manufacturers and industrial processes
-Inspection of processes, materials, and assemblies
-Load and functionality tests
-Technical control for regulatory and contractual compliance
servicio.texto2:
We ensure the conformity and traceability of materials from their origin to their destination. Our approach combines technical inspection, document control, identification of non-conformities, and inventory management, ensuring reliable and verified deliveries at every stage of the supply.
Includes:
-Factory inspection (QA/QC) and production certification
-Supervision of material tests and technical validation
-Traceability of components and critical lots
-Control and documentation of non-conformities
-Inventory management and technical audits
-Consolidation, processing, and organization of technical documentation
-Management of client–supplier relationships to ensure reliable materials and efficient processes
servicio.texto3:
We coordinate and manage the entire supply logistics chain, integrating engineering, inspection, and technical control with efficient logistics processes. We ensure that materials are manufactured, dispatched, and received on time, in form, and according to the project's technical requirements.
Includes:
-Comprehensive logistics planning and route optimization
-Coordination of manufacturing, packaging, and international transport
-Supervision of dispatches, shipments, and deliveries
-Real-time traceability platform and control of logistics milestones
-Technical reception and control at yards or work fronts
-Design of flexible logistics solutions for cost and time reduction
-Field operational support in coordination with engineering and quality

politica.sgi.texto: At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, a company dedicated to supervision and logistics control in strategic sectors, we reaffirm our commitment to quality, occupational health and safety, and environmental protection. Our Integrated Management System (SGI) is aligned with the requirements of ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 standards, and with applicable current regulations. We guide our actions to meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders through the following commitments:
politica.sgi.texto2:
1. Commitment to Quality: We are committed to offering services that meet the highest quality standards, satisfying the needs and expectations of our clients, ensuring continuous improvement in every project we develop.
2. Environmental Protection: We implement responsible practices for environmental management, including pollution prevention, efficient use of resources, proper waste disposal, and reduction of negative impacts from our operations, in accordance with ISO 14001:2015 guidelines.
3. Occupational Health and Safety: We guarantee safe and healthy working conditions, eliminating hazards and minimizing risks. We promote a culture of accident prevention, occupational diseases, and unsafe behaviors, in compliance with ISO 45001:2018 standards.
4. Legal Compliance and Other Requirements: We ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and commitments in quality, environment, and occupational health and safety, as well as those acquired with our clients and stakeholders, in accordance with ISO standards.
5. Risk and Opportunity Management: We identify, evaluate, and manage risks and opportunities in our processes, ensuring operational continuity, innovation, and continuous improvement of the Integrated Management System, as required by ISO 9001:2015.
6. Participation and Consultation: We encourage the participation and consultation of our collaborators and stakeholders, ensuring that their contributions are considered for the design and improvement of our operations and management systems.
7. Training and Awareness: We promote the development of competencies in our human team through continuous training programs, ensuring understanding of the importance of quality, environmental care, and occupational safety in our operations.
8. Strategic Alignment: We ensure that our policy and the objectives of the Integrated Management System are aligned with the organizational strategy, integrating them into all business activities and decisions.
9. Accessibility and Transparency: This policy is communicated to all collaborators, suppliers, contractors, and other stakeholders, ensuring its understanding, application, and public availability to reinforce our commitment to continuous improvement.
10. Continuous Improvement: We constantly work on improving our Integrated Management System, ensuring excellence in our operations and results.
At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, we have a highly qualified human team, advanced technological resources, and an efficient organizational structure. Consolidating our leadership in quality, sustainability, and safety, and ensuring the satisfaction of our clients and the fulfillment of our responsibilities to stakeholders.
politica.af: POLICY FOR THE PREVENTION OF ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG DEPENDENCE
politica.af.texto: CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS is firmly committed to maintaining a completely healthy and safe work environment for all our workers and contractors. The consumption of alcohol and drugs produces effects on the body that cause alterations in physical and mental abilities, greatly affecting health, safety, efficiency, productivity, and putting those around us at risk. For this reason, we recognize as a fundamental activity the creation of awareness for the prevention of alcohol and psychoactive substance use, promoting the well-being, health, and safety of all our workers.
politica.af.texto2:
In accordance with the above, the management of CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS has decided:
1. Prohibit the consumption, use, possession, distribution, transportation, and sale of alcohol, illegal drugs, controlled substances, inhalants, and those classified as narcotics on our premises, at our works, in vehicles, and generally while performing activities for our organization.
2. Prohibit any worker or contractor under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, controlled substances, inhalants, and narcotics from entering or remaining on our premises or those of third parties where the organization is carrying out any work or task.
*Note: For the purposes of this policy, “being under the influence” means having alcohol or any intoxicating drink or controlled substance in the body to such a degree that a urine, blood, or breath/saliva test yields positive results.
3. Develop programs specifically aimed at preventing the use of alcohol and drugs. Non-compliance with this Policy by workers and contractors of CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS will be considered a serious offense and will result in disciplinary action, which may include immediate termination of their contract, in accordance with current legislation.
CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS invites any employee suffering from alcohol or drug dependence to sign a declaration of their illness, to proceed with case evaluation, understanding that in handling these situations, there will be full respect for the employee's right to privacy and good name, and full adherence to Colombian labor legislation.
CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS expresses its commitment to providing support in the rehabilitation process through coordination of appropriate care by competent health entities.
politica.al: POLICY FOR THE PREVENTION OF WORKPLACE AND SEXUAL HARASSMENT
politica.al.texto: At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, we are committed to ensuring a respectful, safe, and harassment-free work environment. We recognize that such behaviors affect the dignity of individuals and have negative impacts on well-being and productivity. Therefore, we adopt a zero-tolerance policy towards harassment, in compliance with Law 1010 of 2006 and other applicable regulations in Colombia.
politica.al.texto2:
We understand workplace and sexual harassment as any unwanted conduct, action, or expression that creates an intimidating, humiliating, or abusive environment, whether in person, virtually, or by any other means. These behaviors are prohibited at all levels of the organization and apply in any work modality.
This policy is integrated into our Occupational Health and Safety Management System (SG-SST), through which we promote prevention, awareness, and training activities to foster an ethical and respectful work environment. In addition, we ensure that any complaint or report is handled confidentially, impartially, and in accordance with due process.
Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS is committed to constant monitoring of this policy, ensuring its effectiveness and alignment with our organizational values and current regulations. Our goal is to consolidate a culture of respect, coexistence, and well-being for all collaborators and stakeholders.
politica.sv.texto: CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS is committed to establishing activities to promote and prevent accidents on public roads; therefore, all people working in the organization must participate in activities required to prevent road accidents. This is to avoid incidents and accidents that may affect the physical, mental, and social integrity of employees, contractors, the general community, and the environment. Strategies are established to raise awareness and train workers through training on road accident issues, traffic regulations, signage, and the use of road language for vehicles, bicycles, cars, motorcycles, and others.
politica.sv.texto2:
To fulfill this commitment, CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS makes the following indications:
1. It is mandatory for all personnel to comply with Regulations, Traffic and Transport Rules, Technical Specifications of transport in force in the National Territory, and others subscribed by the organization, such as those of the community and clients regarding Traffic, Mobility, and Road Safety.
2. It is necessary to apply the values of Courtesy and Respect by anyone performing activities for or on behalf of the organization towards drivers and road users.
3. It is prohibited to transport unauthorized personnel who do not work for or on behalf of the organization in any of its vehicles, as well as to transport equipment, tools, goods, and other items unrelated to the organization without authorization records from CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS.
4. It is mandatory that every driver or operator working for or on behalf of CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS has documents accrediting the basic knowledge to perform each operation activity (on motorcycle and vehicle), Defensive Driving, and specifics such as emergency response.
5. It is prohibited to drive organization vehicles under the influence of alcoholic beverages and/or psychoactive substances, or while consuming tobacco derivatives.
6. Every driver serving the organization is obliged to immediately report to the administration area any incident or detected damage and leave a written and photographic record if applicable.
7. Every employee, contractor, or subcontractor must wear a seat belt whenever driving, no matter how short the trip, and is responsible for ensuring that every occupant of the vehicle uses it correctly, appropriately, and safely at all times.
8. Speed limits established by authorities must be respected.
Violation of any guideline of this policy or opposition to inspection will be considered a serious offense, and consequently, the organization may take disciplinary measures that, after prior investigation, may result in termination of the contract for just cause as established in the Internal Work Regulations and the Law, as applicable.
Management will allocate the necessary financial, human, and technical resources to comply with this policy.
politica.si.texto: At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, we understand that information is one of our most valuable assets and a fundamental pillar for providing our services in software development and the creation of technological applications. The purpose of the following information security policy is to establish guidelines and controls for the protection of information managed in the system, helping to minimize risks associated with unauthorized access, information loss, and cyber threats.
politica.si.texto2:
In compliance with current regulations, Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS defines the information security and digital security policy model, which provides principles and responsibilities regarding information security, providing a reference framework for the prevention, detection, and response to security incidents.
This policy is mandatory for all users, administrators, developers, clients, and third parties who have access to our information. The implementation of this policy ensures compliance with current regulations and good security practices, aligned with quality standards.
The objective of this information security policy is to protect information, systems, computer equipment, and everything related to the technological infrastructure of Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS from any unauthorized access, information loss, information alteration, or infrastructure from any other threat that may arise in the operation and management of the company's systems and that may compromise information security.
This information security policy applies to all information assets of Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS that make up information systems, networks, servers, databases, applications, corporate or personal devices that have access to confidential information used within the company. Any exception to this policy must be evaluated and approved by the IT Department and administrative staff.
Rules and application guidelines:
Access control: Only authorized personnel can access sensitive systems and data.
Audits and risk assessments: Conducted periodically to mitigate vulnerabilities.
Software and system updates: Security patches and constant maintenance will be applied.
Incident management: Clear procedures will be established for identifying and resolving threats.
Awareness and training: Employees will be regularly trained in good cybersecurity practices, fostering a security culture throughout the organization.
Database security: Implementation of encryption, access segmentation, and query auditing.
Availability and redundancy: Use of replication mechanisms and secure storage.
Non-compliance with this policy may result in disciplinary sanctions in accordance with internal regulations and current legal regulations. This policy will be reviewed and updated periodically to ensure its effectiveness and adaptation to new technological challenges.
politica.in.texto: At CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS, we recognize that innovation is a crucial driver for sustainable growth and competitiveness in the global market. Our commitment to innovation allows us to offer high-quality supervision and logistics control solutions, adapting to the changing needs of our clients and emerging trends in the civil works, electrical, telecommunications, metalworking, and other engineering sectors.
politica.in.texto2:
Policy Objectives:
1. Foster a Culture of Innovation: Promote an environment where all employees feel inspired and empowered to contribute innovative ideas that drive the company's development.
2. Continuous Improvement: Implement processes that allow for the constant evaluation and improvement of our services, ensuring we maintain a social, financial, and quality balance in all our operations.
3. Development and Adoption of Technologies: Invest in the development and adoption of advanced technologies, including our own software, to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our real-time project tracking services.
4. Sustainability and Social Responsibility: Integrate sustainable practices into our daily operations and projects, ensuring that our innovations contribute positively to society and the environment.
Implementation and Monitoring
1. Innovation Committee: Create an innovation committee responsible for overseeing the implementation of this policy, ensuring that initiatives align with the company's strategic objectives.
2. Periodic Review: Conduct periodic reviews of the innovation policy to adapt it to changes in the business and technological environment.
3. Annual Innovation Report: Publish an annual report detailing achievements and challenges in our innovation initiatives, maintaining transparency with all our stakeholders.
At CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS, we are dedicated to staying at the forefront of innovation in our operating sectors. This innovation policy is a commitment to our employees, clients, and partners to continue creating innovative solutions that improve our services and contribute positively to global development.
politica.co.texto:
Objective
Establish commercial guidelines and procedures that optimize the management of supervision and logistics control, focusing on customer satisfaction and operational efficiency through innovation and continuous improvement, maintaining a social, financial, and quality balance.
politica.co.texto2:
Scope
This policy applies to all commercial activities of CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS, including interaction with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders in the civil works, electrical, telecommunications, metalworking, and other engineering sectors.
Guidelines
1. Customer Focus
➢ Understanding Customer Needs:
Conduct detailed and regular analyses of each client's needs and expectations.
Indicator: NPS (Net Promoter Score) and customer satisfaction surveys.
➢ Effective Communication:
Establish a regular communication protocol with clients.
Indicator: Response times and customer satisfaction levels.
➢ Quotation Effectiveness:
Action: Measure the percentage of approved quotations over effective ones.
Indicator: Quotation approval rate.
➢ Quotation Database:
Action: Create a database of quotations and their traceability.
Indicator: Accuracy and accessibility of quotation records.
2. Innovation and Continuous Improvement
➢ Adoption of Advanced Technologies:
Integrate real-time project tracking software.
Indicator: Reduction in project cycle times and management transparency.
➢ Continuous Training:
Implement a regular training program for staff.
Indicator: Number of training hours and certifications obtained.
3. Social, Financial, and Quality Balance
➢ Adoption of Advanced Technologies:
Integrate real-time project tracking software.
Indicator: Reduction in project cycle times and management transparency. ➢ Continuous Training:
Implement a regular training program for staff.
Indicator: Number of training hours and certifications obtained.
4. Supplier Relations
➢ Adoption of Advanced Technologies:
Integrate real-time project tracking software.
Indicator: Reduction in project cycle times and management transparency.
➢ Continuous Training:
Implement a regular training program for staff.
Indicator: Number of training hours and certifications obtained.
5. Expansion and Diversification
➢ Exploration of New Markets:
Identify and seize opportunities in emerging markets and complementary sectors.
Indicator: Update potential project databases every 6 months.
➢ Service Diversification: Expand our service offering to meet the diverse needs of our clients and increase our competitiveness in the market.
Indicator: Evaluation of potential business lines every 6 months.
Procedures
1. Contract Negotiation and Closing
➢ Establish clear procedures for contract negotiation, ensuring fair and beneficial terms for both parties.
Indicator: Negotiation efficiency and contract closing time.
➢ Use technological tools to facilitate the contract signing and management process.
2. Project Monitoring and Evaluation
➢ Implement our real-time tracking software to monitor project progress.
Indicator: Compliance with deadlines and objectives.
➢ Conduct periodic evaluations to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance with established objectives.
Customer Payment Methods 1. Credit
➢ Offer credit between 15 and 30 days as established in the contract signed with the client.
➢ Conduct a detailed assessment of the client's solvency before granting credit, using financial analysis tools and credit reports to ensure their payment capacity.
➢ Indicator: Delinquency rate and average collection time for accounts receivable.
2. Payment Method
➢ Bank Transfer: Payments must be made by bank transfer according to the bank certification sent.
This policy will be reviewed and updated periodically to ensure its adequacy to changes in the environment and the company's needs. Performance indicators will be established to measure the effectiveness of the guidelines and procedures described herein.
politica.ac: ANTI-CORRUPTION AND PUBLIC RISK CONTROL POLICY
politica.ac.texto: CONSORCIO QUTUB MINAR SAS is a national company that provides supervision and logistics control services for the supply of products and materials in the civil works, electrical, telecommunications, metalworking, and other engineering sectors. Committed to the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and business ethics, it establishes this Anti-Corruption and Public Risk Management Policy to prevent, detect, and sanction any form of corruption within its operations and relationships with public and private entities.
politica.ac.texto2:
This policy is aligned with national legal regulations and international anti-corruption standards. In accordance with Law 1474 of 2011 (Anti-Corruption Statute) and other current regulations in Colombia, as well as ensuring compliance with international anti-corruption laws to effectively manage public risks associated with bribery, fraud, embezzlement, and other financial crimes; this policy applies to:
• All employees, managers, and contractors of Consorcio Qutub Minar.
• Suppliers, business partners, contractors, and any other stakeholder who maintains a business relationship with the company.
• All operations and projects both in Colombia and abroad.
Thus, a culture of ethics and integrity is promoted in all activities of Consorcio Qutub Minar, including the prohibition of bribery, prevention of conflicts of interest, and limitations on gifts and hospitality.
politica.pd.texto:
At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, we recognize the importance of ensuring the balance between the work and personal life of our collaborators as an essential pillar for their well-being and productivity. Therefore, we adopt the Work Disconnection Policy, in compliance with Law 2191 of 2022, which regulates this right in Colombia and establishes provisions applicable to all work modalities within the organization.
Work disconnection constitutes the right of collaborators not to attend communications or perform work activities outside their previously established working hours, except in exceptional or emergency situations, duly justified and authorized by the company. This commitment covers all collaborators, including those who perform their duties remotely or from home, where the boundaries between work and personal life can be more easily blurred.
politica.pd.texto2:
At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, we are committed to planning activities, responsibilities, and work meetings within the stipulated schedule, promoting respect for the personal and family time of collaborators. Likewise, we promote an organizational culture that supports the right to work disconnection, as a measure to prevent psychosocial risks derived from excessive workload or lack of boundaries between professional responsibilities and private life.
This policy is integrated into the Occupational Health and Safety Management System (SG-SST), through which we implement strategies to mitigate risks associated with insufficient disconnection, especially in the context of teleworking and remote work. We also reinforce our commitment to continuous awareness and training of collaborators, so that they understand the importance of this right and its contribution to the development of a respectful and sustainable work environment.
At Consorcio Qutub Minar SAS, we reaffirm our commitment to current regulations and continuously work on implementing practices that promote the comprehensive well-being of our human team. This policy will be periodically reviewed to ensure its effectiveness and alignment with the organization's strategic objectives and the labor rights enshrined in Colombian legislation.
